setting: S^2(Lambda) x S^2(Lambda), Ric=Lambda*g, Ozuch P=1/2*nabla^*nabla - R^circ

scalar_kernel.quotient_invariant_axial_modes: u1=z-coordinate on first sphere and u2=z-coordinate on second sphere are invariant under pi-rotation, giving u1*g1,u1*g2,u2*g1,u2*g2 on the orbifold

gauge_directions.factor1: L_{grad f} g = 2 Hess f = -2*Lambda*f*g1, so the Bianchi-surviving u1*g1 mode is pure gauge
gauge_directions.factor2: L_{grad f} g = 2 Hess f = -2*Lambda*f*g2, so the Bianchi-surviving u2*g2 mode is pure gauge

consequence.warning: Ozuch Definition 1.8 uses the full L2 kernel of P. A calculation may either include the four full-kernel projections/variables or replace Ozuch's setup by an explicitly derived slice. It is invalid to delete the projections by citing only TT-kernel vanishing.
